description.text: The other expansion that opened the Sun & Moon series on 9 December 2016, released together with Collection Sun; the two packs brought the first Pokémon-GX. Collection Moon holds Lunala-GX with Lurantis-GX, Umbreon-GX and Tauros-GX, among many new Pokémon of the Alola region. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 60, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Team Skull Grunt and Lillie, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Nest Ball, Switch and Psychic Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Sun & Moon in February 2017.
